meta.notes: Counts = number of sample entries with >=1 match. Apply citation rules in order author -> journal -> collection, marking consumed spans. Regexes tested with Python re, flags=re.M.

rules.comment: group1=KB text, group2=type (posl/pogov), group3=RU translation (+equivalent). Marker stands BETWEEN original and translation. Russian equivalents containing ';' spill into next segment.
group1=KB riddle, group2=RU translation, group3=answer (KB + RU gloss). Closing paren of otgadka sometimes missing in OCR.
Literal translation note inside RU part of a proverb/phraseme translation.

Folklore formulas / blessings. CAUTION: 'фольк.' after 'а)'/'б)' is a stylistic label of a translation branch, not a folklore formula (e_01237 'б) фольк. жар-птица') - filter matches whose KB part ends with а)/б).
Stem/possessive-form note at the very beginning of misc1, e.g. '(гъу);' for тауукъ.
Spelling/form variants: leading-hyphen alternative ending ('-турх') or regional RU variant ('тамга обл.').

Literary citation attribution: 'Фамилияланы И., Title, [vol,] page.' incl. Russian authors 'М. Шолохов, ...'. Titles with internal commas are truncated at first comma but attribution is still detected. Quote TEXT extends left to previous attribution/marker - exact left boundary needs sentence heuristics or LLM.
Folklore-collection / textbook attribution: '«Малкъар халкъ жырла», 215.'. Overlaps with periodical rule - apply periodical first and skip consumed spans.
Proverb used as illustration: sentence + '(Нарт сёз.)' / '(Фольк.)'. OCR variant '(Нарт сёз).' (dot outside) covered. Captures one sentence; multi-sentence proverbs are rare.

Phraseology block. AMBIGUOUS: in ~half the cases ◊ directly precedes a plain literary quotation, not a phraseme (e_00718). Deterministic sub-filter: block starts with short KB phrase + RU gloss (+ optional ' / ' KB def) => phraseme; otherwise treat as citation. Residual classification needs LLM.
Compound-term block: 'KB-term RU-translation / KB-definition. Citations'. Both U+25A1 and U+25AF occur - keep both in the class.
Cross-reference 'къ. word [N] [(M-чи магъ.)]'. 13/98 entries START with къ. (pure reference sense/entry). Also occurs inside ◊-blocks ('Таякъ тийди къ. жетди') - store position/level.

Grammar formulas for derived verbs/nouns: 'X дегенни зорлаучу/къатланыучу/араш айырмасы', 'X дегенден этим ат'. OCR tolerance: 'айрмасы' (e_00006). Reliable signal that the entry is a grammatical derivative.
Bilingual gloss 'RU translation / KB definition' inside ◊/□ blocks and // shades. group1=RU, group2=KB. Risk: '/' in dates/fractions elsewhere in corpus (none in sample).
Numbered sense boundaries within misc2. Lookahead avoids page numbers in citations (', 3.'). Shade-of-meaning marker '//' (11 entries) splits sub-senses further.
Editorial context note inside quotations '[Speaker to addressee:]'. Annotation helper, not a standalone subfield - keep attached to its citation.
